title: Agent Runtime
description: Kit slot health, hook mounts, relationship lookup, and cognition index (world hubs / node articles). Kits and relationship stay read-only; rebuild mount never touches the memory graph.
backendTooOld: This gsuid_core build is too old and lacks the runtime diagnostics APIs. Please upgrade the backend.

slots.sealedEmptyHint: A sealed slot (outbound speech / identity anchor) has no occupant. The safety surface is open.
slots.empty: The backend returned no kit slots.

hooks.hint: wired=false means the contract exists but the kernel does not fire there yet — not a fault. A wired point with empty owners usually means the matching slot is off.

relationship.title: Look up relationship temperature
relationship.desc: The score is an internal value, shown only here. last_reason explains a sudden cooldown.
relationship.scoreHint: Do not expose the score to the model or chat UI.

cognition.title: Cognition node search
cognition.desc: Nodes store identity / summary / handle only. World knowledge lives on public world: hubs; articles hang on the node while the body stays in knowledge / plugins / FileOS.
cognition.aclHint: Leaving owner empty hides owner-required kinds such as tool_output / artifact. This is not a god-view.
cognition.worldHint: Empty scope = public world hubs. A group: / user_global: scope also shows env mirrors whose canon points at world:. Rebuild mount never touches the memory graph.
cognition.rebuildHint: Clears attachments and world/ent mirrors, then remounts. Episode / Entity / Edge rows are left alone. Plugin articles stay read-only; agent articles remount onto existing hubs.
cognition.noAttachments: This hub has no attached articles yet.
